title: Customers
answer: Customers manages the customer master: contact details, tags, credit balance, and loyalty points. Available to any authenticated user. Feeds POS (lookup and redemption), Returns (store-credit refunds), Customer Orders, and WhatsApp Marketing (segment targeting).

title: How does a customer's credit balance work?
answer: Credit Balance is a signed number: positive means the store owes the customer (typically from a store-credit refund); a negative balance would mean the customer owes the store. It's spent automatically the next time this customer is selected at POS and credit is applied to a sale, capped at their actual balance.

title: What does the VIP toggle actually change?
answer: VIP doubles loyalty points earned on every future sale (1 point per Rs.100 becomes 2 per Rs.100) and is the qualifying condition for any discount rule marked "VIP only".

title: What are customer tags used for?
answer: Free-form tags set on a customer are what WhatsApp Marketing's "Tag" segment type uses to target a campaign. Set a tag here first if you want to reach this specific group of customers later.

title: Viewing and editing customer records has no role restriction
answer: Any authenticated user, any role, can view and edit the full customer record including credit balance and contact details. If a store expects only certain roles to access customer data, this is not currently enforced.

title: A manual credit or loyalty adjustment can push the balance negative
answer: A manual credit or loyalty-points adjustment (distinct from what checkout redeems) has no lower-bound check, unlike redemption at checkout which is capped at the customer's actual balance. It's possible to push either figure negative through a manual adjustment.

title: Tailor & Alterations
answer: Tailor & Alterations logs post-sale garment alteration jobs: customer, item, description, tailor name, status, and collection date. Available to any authenticated user; no linked sale is required to create a job.

title: Does an alteration job show up on a tailor's work queue?
answer: No. Tailor & Alterations and the Manufacturing module's Tailors/Work Orders are completely unconnected - they share a word, not a data relationship. This screen's "Tailor" field is a plain typed name, not a link to anyone in the Manufacturing Tailors roster. A job logged here never appears on a real tailor's My Work queue, and a real tailor resource (with pay rate, skills, workload) isn't selectable here at all. If a store needs alteration jobs tracked against a real tailor's workload, use Manufacturing's Work Orders instead.

title: Why did an alteration's status jump to Assigned automatically?
answer: Typing a tailor name at creation immediately sets status to Assigned instead of Requested. Leaving the tailor name blank keeps the job in Requested until someone is named.

title: Alterations has no role restriction on creating or updating jobs
answer: Any authenticated user can create or update an alteration job - there is a permission code defined for this in the system, but it is not currently enforced by this screen.

title: WhatsApp Marketing
answer: WhatsApp Marketing composes and sends segment-targeted campaigns: name, audience, optional schedule, message body with placeholder tokens, saved templates, and media. Requires manager role or above. Requires a WhatsApp Cloud API connection configured under Settings, and at least one customer with a phone or WhatsApp number.

title: What segment types are available for a campaign?
answer: All customers, VIP only, a specific tag, customers who bought a category/brand within a lookback window, customers inactive for N days, or customers with a birthday this month. Every segment silently excludes anyone with no phone/WhatsApp number and anyone marked inactive - there is no way to reach either group from this screen.

title: What does Preview Audience do?
answer: A dry run - shows exactly how many customers currently match the chosen segment, with a few sample names, and sends nothing. Always check this before scheduling; a segment matching zero people will refuse to send.

title: Why does only a quick-reply button work in a campaign message?
answer: Only a quick-reply button renders as a real, tappable WhatsApp button. A link, phone-number, or catalog button is appended to the message as a plain text line instead, because WhatsApp requires those to go through a pre-approved template outside an active customer conversation, which this feature doesn't use.

title: Saved templates are not Meta-approved WhatsApp templates - watch the 24-hour window
answer: Saved "templates" here are free-text snippets, not WhatsApp Business's pre-approved message templates. A message sent to a customer who hasn't messaged the business in the last 24 hours will be rejected by WhatsApp, with no warning shown in the compose screen - it will simply show as a failed delivery for that recipient afterward.

title: A campaign's "Sent" status doesn't mean everyone received it
answer: A campaign's overall status reads Sent the moment even a single recipient succeeds - a campaign that reached 12 of 150 people still shows Sent, not "Mostly failed". Open the campaign's own delivery report for the real per-recipient breakdown.

title: A campaign shows "Sent" but a customer says they never received it
answer: Open that campaign's delivery report and find their specific row - the headline Sent status only means at least one recipient succeeded. A common individual cause: no message has been sent to that customer in the last 24 hours, so WhatsApp rejected this one as outside an active conversation window.

title: Dashboard
answer: Dashboard is the landing screen after login: summary tiles, a customizable widget layout, low-stock list, sales trend and payment-mode charts. Available to any authenticated user.

title: If I customize my Dashboard, does it change it for everyone?
answer: No. Customize saves your layout to your own browser only - it's a personal view, not a team-wide setting, and it won't follow you to a different device or browser.

title: Reports
answer: Reports has two tabs only: Stock Aging and Dead Stock, bucketing items by days since last sale (0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 91-180 / 180+). Requires manager role or above.

title: Manufacturing's cost, wastage, and tailor-productivity reports exist but have no menu path
answer: Manufacturing has its own reports - production cost summary, wastage, and tailor productivity - fully built and working on the server, but there is no button, tab, or link anywhere in the application that opens them. They exist only as direct backend calls; nobody using the app through its normal screens can currently reach them.

title: Why does a brand-new item show up in the oldest aging bucket?
answer: An item with no sale history is treated as idle since its creation date, not excluded from these reports. A genuinely new item that hasn't sold yet will show up in the oldest bucket if it simply sits long enough, the same as a slow-moving one.
